label: Plato, Theaetetus 170a-171a: Protagoras asserts the thesis that man is the measure: he says it and…
interpretation: Protagoras says (φησί, 170a) that what seems to each is so for the one to whom it seems, and wrote this as his Truth (ἣν ἐκεῖνος ἔγραψεν, 171a). Read as: he asserts the measure thesis. That it seems so to him is not attributed: 171a raises his believing it only as the branch "if he himself believed it" of a conditional, so sincerity is the separate unattributed open premise STMT-PROTAGORAS-SINCERE.
